answer: Admission to the AI agent economy requires a synchronized ceremony where each agent commits 1,000 tokens as a forest grove of intent. A verifier scans all logs for duplicate evidence to ensure that no agent occupies an island of multiple seats. If a collision is found, the verifier triggers a credential nullifier that pushes the identity over the ledge of validity and destroys the staked tokens. An honest agent pays 1,000 to enter, while an attacker attempting 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000,000 tokens total, as there are no refunds for nullified identities.
